Based on what I can see, this is a Streamlit-based web app for automated exploratory data analysis. Here are my suggestions for renaming the folder:

## Best Options:

1. **`data-insight-tool`** - Clean, professional, describes what it does
2. **`eda-wizard`** - Friendly, implies ease of use 
3. **`quick-eda`** - Short, clear, emphasizes the automation/speed aspect
4. **`data-explorer`** - Simple and self-explanatory
5. **`insight-hub`** - Modern, broader appeal

## More Specific Options:

6. **`streamlit-eda`** - If you want to highlight the tech stack
7. **`data-profiler`** - Professional term for this type of tool
8. **`autoeda`** - Short and direct
9. **`eda-studio`** - Suggests a more comprehensive tool
10. **`data-lens`** - Metaphorical, clean name

## My Recommendation:

I'd go with **`quick-eda`** or **`data-insight-tool`** because they:
- Are clear about the purpose
- Work well as repository names (lowercase with hyphens)
- Are memorable and professional
- Don't have underscores (more common in modern naming conventions)

The current `EDA_Automation` is functional but a bit generic. Which style appeals to you - short and punchy (`quick-eda`) or more descriptive (`data-insight-tool`)?
